title: Post the 1.3.0 Patreon + Discord announcements from MadPony-Identity, using the corrected Klein copy
description: The 1.3.0 Patreon and Discord announcements have not gone out yet. They are written from Cubric Vision's release notes, which carried a sentence telling users to press a Remove control the app does not have; that copy was corrected in ca0eb45e (MPI-423), so the announcements must be written from the CORRECTED text. Work happens in the sibling repo c:/AI/Mpi/MadPony-Identity (capabilities/patreon/ and capabilities/discord/, plus discord-ops.md), NOT here. Source of truth for the copy is this repo: docs/releases/2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md and js/data/releaseNotes.js RELEASE_NOTES['1.3.0']; docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md is empty of 1.3.0 content (already flushed at the cut) and is the source for the NEXT release, not this one. The Klein sentence must read 'mask an object, run Inpaint with the prompt left empty' - never 'hit Remove', which would send readers to Remove Background and give them the inverse of what they wanted. Tick Patreon and Discord on the Platform Update Checklist at the bottom of the release doc once posted.
acceptance: The 1.3.0 Patreon post is published, written from docs/releases/2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md as it reads NOW
The 1.3.0 Discord #updates post is published, with the download link
Neither post says 'hit Remove' - the Klein line reads 'mask an object, run Inpaint with the prompt left empty'
Patreon and Discord are ticked on the Platform Update Checklist at the bottom of docs/releases/2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md
